correctness.rationale: The uncovered vertices U_A,U_B characterize domination: no cross-edge may join uncovered endpoints, so one side is fully covered or both uncovered sides are the same singleton. Removing an essential edge proves the perfect matching, one-sided restricted surjection, and matched-hole star-forest cases; the one-hole map must give f(j) a unique preimage, otherwise that edge is inessential. The EGF exp(W) labels components of complete-bipartite star forests; inclusion-exclusion over forbidden diagonal edges works because disjoint forced matching edges belong to distinct stars, each contributing z(exp(zx)+exp(zy)-1). Component-count bounds yield n-1 and 2n-4 extrema with stated parameter qualifications. Independent full subset enumeration n=2,3,4 reproduced all size distributions; original verify.py was inspected, not used as proof.
